messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — HIGH: GPU capacity exhaustion in prod-eu (inference-queue). Paging oncall-anna. Queue growth > 6m, 90th latency spiking, autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes.
oncall-anna: on it. Acknowledged. jumping in.
ben-sre: I see the autoscaler error in logs: `Failed to attach instance profile: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole` when creating nodes for nodegroup `gpu-pool-eu-rt`.
carmen-ops: Confirming customers are seeing generation timeouts and backpressure. Support reports multiple 503s for some trial orgs. Putting banner?
customer-bridge-bot: Notifying affected customers: some sandbox customers seeing high latency; no data plane errors reported.
dinesh-infra: Quick metric: ASG gpu-pool-eu has reached max size (10/10). Cloud console shows scale requests denied. Could be ASG limit + stale launch template version referencing removed IAM role.
eva-eng: From cloud audit logs: `iam:PassRole` denied to autoscaler role arn:aws:iam::xxxx:role/k8s-autoscaler-role. Looks like role policy removed in last deploy.
ben-sre: That matches. Autoscaler tries to pass role `ec2-gpu-attach-role` to instances but doesn't have permission. Autoscaler error stream: `error attaching profile: AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: role ec2-gpu-attach-role`
oncall-anna: Plan options: 1) temp increase ASG max and create nodes manually with correct instance profile, 2) restore PassRole permission to autoscaler role, 3) re-run nodegroup create with latest LT. Which is fastest?
carmen-ops: 2 looks fastest if we can push a policy patch. Who can approve? sec-bot?
sec-bot: I can approve emergency exemption for `iam:PassRole` to k8s-autoscaler-role for the scope `arn:aws:iam::xxxx:role/ec2-gpu-attach-role` for 30m. Need ticket reference.
dinesh-infra: I'll prepare a minimal inline policy and push via infra-runbook. Attaching now: `iam:PassRole` on that single role only.
eva-eng: Meanwhile, pods are building up in the inference queue. Workaround: switch small percentage of traffic to fallback model (cpu) to shed tokens. Doing a 10% traffic split now via routing config.
ben-sre: kubectl describe from cluster showing pods pending: `0/12 nodes are available: 12 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 4 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate` — looks like some existing nodes had taint propagation set to `NoSchedule` and new nodes would have same taint from launch template.
eva-eng: Good catch — our LT has a taint script. When autoscaler creates nodes they get tainted `gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule`. Pods require toleration but some older pods don't have it. That explains some scheduling failures even after nodes appear.
oncall-anna: Status update: dinesh applied policy patch (PassRole) at +3m. Autoscaler retried - created two new instances but they failed because LT version referenced a missing instance profile metadata. Trying manual create via ASG with latest LT v8.
dinesh-infra: Manual scale-up: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-eu --desired-capacity 12` — creating two on-demand nodes with LT v8.
ben-sre: New nodes booting. kubectl shows `node/gpu-eu-12 Ready` but taint applied. I'm removing the taint temporarily to let pods schedule: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-eu-12 gpu-reserved-`
eva-eng: Removing taints on the two new nodes. Pods are now scheduling and pod backlog is draining. Queue length dropped from 8k to 1.2k in 6m.
carmen-ops: Customer impact: Support tracking ~18 orgs with elevated latency, highest SLAs impacted for 3 paid customers — escalation opened to account team.
support-leads: We're coordinating messages. No PII or data compromise. Priority: restore capacity, then iterate on LT and policies.
ben-sre: Follow-up: we need to fix LT so it uses the correct instance profile and avoid applying `gpu-reserved` taint by default, or ensure daemonsets add tolerations.
oncall-anna: Temporary mitigations in place: PassRole restored, ASG max bumped to 14, two nodes manually created, taints removed and routing fallback at 10%. System is in RECOVERY.
sec-bot: Audit note: emergency PassRole grant applied at +3m by dinesh-infra; scheduled to auto-revoke in 30m. Please file IAM change request for permanent fix.
eva-eng: Logs show autoscaler events now normal: `Successfully launched instance i-0abc with profile ec2-gpu-attach-role`. Pods scheduled, GPU utilization spiking as backlog drains.
dinesh-infra: Adding follow-up tasks: 1) revert LT to v9 with fixed instance profile mapping, 2) add permissive tolerations in rollout for inference pods, 3) add unit test for IAM policy drift.
ben-sre: Also add alert for autoscaler iam:PassRole denies and ASG max reached to avoid manual pager next time.
carmen-ops: Update on customer comms: initial hold message sent. Will send a detailed follow-up once confirmed stable.
oncall-anna: Monitoring phase for 30m. If queue < 100 and 95th latency < 1.5s we can close incident and open postmortem.
support-leads: Assigned: postmortem owner = eva-eng, infra fix = dinesh-infra, alerts = ben-sre.
customer-bridge-bot: Customers awaiting update: will send status update in 20m.
ben-sre: Quick snag: found one node running older kubelet causing `node not ready` for a few pods — cordoned and drained, autoscaler will replace.
oncall-anna: Good. Current state: mitigation success, monitoring. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Reminder: create IAM ticket and link incident.
eva-eng: I'll draft a short incident summary and timeline for the postmortem doc.
ben-sre: Final note: root cause looks like recent permissions hardening removed PassRole from autoscaler role and an LT change introduced taint + wrong instance profile. Two-pronged failure: IAM + LT drift => autoscaler couldn't attach + nodes had taints that blocked scheduling.
carmen-ops: Closing loop: status -> MONITORING, impact -> degraded inference latency for subset of customers, mitigation -> restored PassRole, manual node create, taint removal, traffic split to fallback model. Next: permanent LT and policy fixes.
oncall-anna: Closing here in 30m if stable. Kudos team for quick coordination. :trophy:
